title: Lady Snowblood 2: Love Song of Vengeance
writer: Kazuo Kamimura, Kazuo Koike, Norio Osada
actors: Meiko Kaji, Jûzô Itami, Kazuko Yoshiyuki
plot: To avoid a death sentence for her prior acts of bloodshed, the vengeful swordswoman Lady Snowblood is conscripted by the Japanese Secret Police to assassinate political dissidents.
